title: Monk's Friend
start: Speak to Brother Omad at the Monastery south of Ardougne.

items.t: A jug of water (you can buy a jug at the general stores in Port Khazard; there is a sink in a house to the south of the monastery)
Normal logs (there are plenty of trees nearby)

kills.t: You can choose to defeat two level 21 thieves and a level 25 head thief.

steps.t: Talk to Brother Omad on the floor 1 of the Monastery south of East Ardougne zoo. [Chat: 1 Why can't you sleep? › Accept]
Exit the monastery and head west to the location shown on the map, there is a circle of stones (visible on the minimap).
Stand in the circle of stones and climb down the ladder that appears. The stones are the same colour as the grass in high graphics modes, and are very easy to overlook.
Go south, enter the room with thieves, and grab the Child's blanket on the table to the east.
Return to the monastery and talk to Brother Omad. [Chat: 1 Is there anything else I can help with? › 1 Who's Brother Cedric? › 2 Where should I look?]
North of the Monastery and near a crashed cart, Brother Cedric will be wandering around. Talk to him.
Talk to him again to give him a jug of water. [Chat: 2 Yes, I'd be happy to!]
Talk to him once more to give him one log.
Pop a balloon for area task.
